name: helpdesk-team14
description: Helpdesk Platform (Team 14) - Cloudflare Workers + Hono + D1, per PRD v1.0

scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --var ENVIRONMENT:production --var MAINTENANCE_API_URL:https://maintenance-team10.vercel.app/api/v1 --var MAINTENANCE_PORTAL_URL:https://maintenance-team10-kwxt.vercel.app/ --var WELLBEING_REFERRALS:on
scripts.db:local:update: wrangler d1 execute helpdesk-db --local --file=./database/migrations/0003_drop_assigned_status.sql && wrangler d1 execute helpdesk-db --local --file=./database/migrations/0004_guest_profiles.sql && wrangler d1 execute helpdesk-db --local --file=./database/migrations/0005_ticket_location.sql && wrangler d1 execute helpdesk-db --local --file=./database/migrations/0006_privacy_consents.sql
scripts.db:remote:update: wrangler d1 execute helpdesk-db --remote --file=./database/migrations/0003_drop_assigned_status.sql && wrangler d1 execute helpdesk-db --remote --file=./database/migrations/0004_guest_profiles.sql && wrangler d1 execute helpdesk-db --remote --file=./database/migrations/0005_ticket_location.sql && wrangler d1 execute helpdesk-db --remote --file=./database/migrations/0006_privacy_consents.sql
